rationale: Followed the brief's scene in the white/off-white/grey palette; light set to upper-left to match the real pack shots. Props, tints and textures kept in outer or lower areas so the copy and photo zones stay empty. Situation briefs evoke the moment without people or product.

variants.axis_value: Pale peach and off-white colour blocks, soft floor line
variants.image_prompt: Create a photographic background image: a straight-on view of a backdrop of two large flat colour blocks, pale peach #F3E4DA and off-white #F4F2EE, meeting at a soft floor line at 80% of the frame height. Lighting: gentle diffused light from the upper left at 5600K, soft shadows falling to the lower right. Background: matte seamless paper, low saturation. Style: spec sheet geometry, restrained. The top band, about 24% of the height, is intentionally empty, calm and low-detail for headline copy added later. The whole middle band, from 26% to 74% of the height and across the full width, is intentionally empty, an evenly lit open area reserved for a photo and small icons placed later. The bottom quarter of the frame stays plain and calm. Square 1:1, 1024x1024, 50mm lens at f/8 so the whole surface is sharp, fine photographic detail, no film grain. Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, logos, product, bottle, tube, packaging, people, faces, skin, hands.
variants.negative_prompt: Do not include: any text, letters, numbers, logos, product, bottle, tube, packaging, people, faces, skin, hands.
